records.key: A threshold correction factor: Otsu's level is multiplied by it before it is used. Above 1 is stricter, so objects shrink and faint ones drop out; below 1 takes in dimmer pixels; 1 is Otsu's own level. Otsu detect uses it, and so does the Live magnifier's Classical mode wherever a region holds two clear populations.
records.source: A threshold correction factor: Otsu's level is multiplied by it before it is used. Above 1 is stricter, so objects shrink and faint ones drop out; below 1 takes in dimmer pixels; 1 is Otsu's own level. Otsu detect uses it, and so does the Live magnifier's Classical mode wherever a region holds two clear populations.
records.translation: Um fator de correção do limiar: o nível de Otsu é multiplicado por ele antes de ser usado. Acima de 1 é mais rigoroso, por isso os objetos encolhem e os ténues desaparecem; abaixo de 1 inclui píxeis mais ténues; 1 é o próprio nível de Otsu. O Otsu detectar usa-o, tal como o modo Clássico da Lupa em tempo real sempre que uma região contém duas populações bem distintas.

records.key: Browse the model zoo, download a Cellpose model and segment with it. The model chosen there is selected in the list beside this button.
records.source: Browse the model zoo, download a Cellpose model and segment with it. The model chosen there is selected in the list beside this button.
records.translation: Explore o zoo de modelos, transfira um modelo Cellpose e segmente com ele. O modelo escolhido é selecionado na lista ao lado deste botão.

records.key: DINOCell appears in Mode once installed: pip install "spacr[dinocell]"
records.source: DINOCell appears in Mode once installed: pip install "spacr[dinocell]"
records.translation: O DINOCell aparece em Mode depois de instalado: pip install "spacr[dinocell]"

records.key: How readily the Classical mode accepts an object. Raise it to take in dimmer or less certain objects, lower it to keep only clear ones; 0 is the default cut. The models read their thresholds from the Cellpose-SAM settings instead, so this is greyed out while another mode is chosen.
records.source: How readily the Classical mode accepts an object. Raise it to take in dimmer or less certain objects, lower it to keep only clear ones; 0 is the default cut. The models read their thresholds from the Cellpose-SAM settings instead, so this is greyed out while another mode is chosen.
records.translation: Com que facilidade o modo Clássico aceita um objeto. Aumente-a para incluir objetos mais ténues ou menos certos, diminua-a para manter só os nítidos; 0 é o corte predefinido. Os modelos leem os seus limiares nas definições do Cellpose-SAM, por isso isto fica a cinzento enquanto outro modo está escolhido.

records.key: SAMCell appears in Mode once installed: pip install "spacr[samcell]"
records.source: SAMCell appears in Mode once installed: pip install "spacr[samcell]"
records.translation: O SAMCell aparece em Mode depois de instalado: pip install "spacr[samcell]"

records.key: Side of the square box, in image pixels, up to the open image's own height or width. Under Region under the mouse it is also the region the model segments, so make it wider than the largest object you want to add. Shift + mouse wheel changes it while the magnifier is on.
records.source: Side of the square box, in image pixels, up to the open image's own height or width. Under Region under the mouse it is also the region the model segments, so make it wider than the largest object you want to add. Shift + mouse wheel changes it while the magnifier is on.
records.translation: Lado da caixa quadrada, em píxeis da imagem, até à altura ou à largura da imagem aberta. Com Região sob o rato é também a região que o modelo segmenta, por isso torne-a mais larga do que o maior objeto que quer adicionar. Shift + roda do rato altera-o enquanto a lupa está ligada.

records.key: The Live magnifier reads these settings too: Cellpose mode uses the model, both thresholds, the diameter and the normalization, DINOCell the cell probability, and Classical mode the Otsu threshold correction.
records.source: The Live magnifier reads these settings too: Cellpose mode uses the model, both thresholds, the diameter and the normalization, DINOCell the cell probability, and Classical mode the Otsu threshold correction.
records.translation: A Lupa em tempo real também lê estas definições: o modo Cellpose usa o modelo, ambos os limiares, o diâmetro e a normalização, o DINOCell a probabilidade de célula, e o modo Clássico a correção do limiar de Otsu.

records.key: Threshold the image at Otsu's level, multiplied by the Otsu threshold correction under Cellpose-SAM, and label what is left, honouring the minimum area above.
records.source: Threshold the image at Otsu's level, multiplied by the Otsu threshold correction under Cellpose-SAM, and label what is left, honouring the minimum area above.
records.translation: Aplica à imagem um limiar ao nível de Otsu, multiplicado pela correção do limiar de Otsu em Cellpose-SAM, e rotula o que resta, respeitando a área mínima acima.

records.key: Which model segments the region in the box. Classical thresholds the region at Otsu's level and splits touching objects with a watershed; it needs nothing installed, follows the Bright switch and the Min area box under Object operations and the Otsu threshold correction under Cellpose-SAM, and runs whenever a model cannot be loaded. Cellpose uses the model, both thresholds, the diameter and the normalization set under Cellpose-SAM, and is slow without a GPU. DINOCell and SAMCell are offered once installed; DINOCell reads the cell probability set under Cellpose-SAM, and SAMCell uses its own thresholds.
records.source: Which model segments the region in the box. Classical thresholds the region at Otsu's level and splits touching objects with a watershed; it needs nothing installed, follows the Bright switch and the Min area box under Object operations and the Otsu threshold correction under Cellpose-SAM, and runs whenever a model cannot be loaded. Cellpose uses the model, both thresholds, the diameter and the normalization set under Cellpose-SAM, and is slow without a GPU. DINOCell and SAMCell are offered once installed; DINOCell reads the cell probability set under Cellpose-SAM, and SAMCell uses its own thresholds.
records.translation: Que modelo segmenta a região na caixa. Clássico aplica à região um limiar ao nível de Otsu e separa objetos que se tocam com uma linha de partilha de águas; não precisa de nada instalado, segue o interruptor Brilhante e a caixa Min area em Operações de objectos e a correção do limiar de Otsu em Cellpose-SAM, e é executado sempre que um modelo não pode ser carregado. O Cellpose usa o modelo, ambos os limiares, o diâmetro e a normalização definidos em Cellpose-SAM, e é lento sem GPU. O DINOCell e o SAMCell são oferecidos quando instalados; o DINOCell lê a probabilidade de célula definida em Cellpose-SAM e o SAMCell usa os seus próprios limiares.

records.key: Which weights segment this field, and the Live magnifier's box in Cellpose mode. The list is the Cellpose installed on this machine and every Cellpose model in the model zoo; a zoo model not downloaded yet is greyed out until Model zoo… fetches it.
records.source: Which weights segment this field, and the Live magnifier's box in Cellpose mode. The list is the Cellpose installed on this machine and every Cellpose model in the model zoo; a zoo model not downloaded yet is greyed out until Model zoo… fetches it.
records.translation: Que pesos segmentam este campo e, no modo Cellpose, a caixa da Lupa em tempo real. A lista é o Cellpose instalado nesta máquina e cada modelo Cellpose do zoo de modelos; um modelo do zoo ainda não transferido fica a cinzento até Model zoo… o obter.
